sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Circulate is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You really gave me a hand with those mules back then. Now everything seems to be ready for retail, but there's not enough momentum to revitalize our economy. Let's show this town how to market!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Sell Ragman any 250 backpacks or tactical rigs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +32,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.01
- 264,000 Roubles
  - 277,200 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 303,600 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
"Now that's more like it! Thank you, brother."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to sell any 250 backpacks or tactical rigs to Ragman.

The sales amount display may not always update immediately. A game restart forces a refresh.
